title: Spectate Player
features:
A clean and simple player spectating system designed for Roblox.

Features:
• Spectate random players with a single click.
• Easily switch between players using the navigation buttons.
• View the selected player's username on screen.
• Teleport directly to the selected player.
• Smooth third-person spectating camera.
• PC camera rotation using the right mouse button.
• Mobile camera rotation with one-finger swiping.
• PC zoom using the mouse wheel.
• Mobile zoom using two-finger pinch gestures.
• Adjustable camera distance from 5 to 30 studs.
• Draggable spectate button.
• Smooth intro animation and interface transitions.
• Fully client-sided and designed to run from StarterPlayerScripts.

Simple interface, smooth controls, and an easy-to-use spectating experience.
